description: Creates or updates customers' tax exemption certificates, matched by ItemId, then by customer and number. Import the customers first.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CustomerId.description: The id of the customer the certificate belongs to.

ExemptionType.description: The kind of exemption, such as Resale.

Status.description: The certificate's status: only an active certificate exempts.

TaxTypes.description: The tax types it exempts from, or none for every type.

JurisdictionIds.description: The jurisdictions it applies in, or none for every one.

ClassificationCodes.description: The product classification codes it covers, or none for every product.

ExemptionCertificates.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
